name: CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark
note: Each test implements the audit procedure of the recommendation it is mapped to. Recommendations that CIS itself marks Manual have no test.

2.1.1.title: Ensure that Azure Databricks is deployed in a customer-managed virtual network (VNet)

2.1.2.title: Ensure that network security groups are configured for Databricks subnets

2.1.3.title: Ensure that traffic is encrypted between cluster worker nodes

2.1.4.title: Ensure that users and groups are synced from Microsoft Entra ID to Azure Databricks

2.1.5.title: Ensure that Unity Catalog is configured for Azure Databricks

2.1.6.title: Ensure that usage is restricted and expiry is enforced for Databricks personal access tokens

2.1.7.title: Ensure that diagnostic log delivery is configured for Azure Databricks

2.1.8.title: Ensure critical data is encrypted with customer managed keys (CMK)

2.1.9.title: Ensure 'No Public IP' is set to 'Enabled'

2.1.10.title: Ensure 'Allow Public Network Access' is set to 'Disabled'

2.1.11.title: Ensure private endpoints are used to access Azure Databricks workspaces

2.1.12.title: Ensure Azure Databricks groups are reviewed periodically

3.1.1.title: Ensure only MFA enabled identities can access privileged Virtual Machine

5.1.1.title: Ensure that 'security defaults' is enabled in Microsoft Entra ID

5.1.2.title: Ensure that 'Require Multifactor Authentication to register or join devices with Microsoft Entra' is set to 'Yes'

5.1.3.title: Ensure that 'Multifactor authentication' is 'enabled' for all users

5.1.4.title: Ensure that 'Allow users to remember multifactor authentication on devices they trust' is disabled

5.3.1.title: Ensure that Azure admin accounts are not used for daily operations

5.3.2.title: Ensure that guest users are reviewed on a regular basis

5.3.3.title: Ensure that use of the 'User Access Administrator' role is restricted

5.3.4.title: Ensure that all 'privileged' role assignments are periodically reviewed

5.3.5.title: Ensure disabled user accounts do not have read, write, or owner permissions

5.3.6.title: Ensure 'Tenant Creator' role assignments are periodically reviewed

5.3.7.title: Ensure all non-privileged role assignments are periodically reviewed

5.4.title: Ensure that no custom subscription administrator roles exist

5.5.title: Ensure that a custom role is assigned permissions for administering resource locks

5.6.title: Ensure that 'Subscription leaving Microsoft Entra tenant' and 'Subscription entering Microsoft Entra tenant' is set to 'Permit no one'

5.7.title: Ensure there are between 2 and 3 subscription owners

6.1.1.1.title: Ensure that a 'Diagnostic Setting' exists for Subscription Activity Logs

6.1.1.2.title: Ensure Diagnostic Setting captures appropriate categories

6.1.1.3.title: Ensure the storage account containing the container with activity logs is encrypted with customer-managed key (CMK)

6.1.1.4.title: Ensure that logging for Azure Key Vault is 'Enabled'

6.1.1.5.title: Ensure that Network Security Group Flow logs are captured and sent to Log Analytics

6.1.1.6.title: Ensure that virtual network flow logs are captured and sent to Log Analytics

6.1.1.7.title: Ensure that a Microsoft Entra diagnostic setting exists to send Microsoft Graph activity logs to an appropriate destination

6.1.1.8.title: Ensure that a Microsoft Entra diagnostic setting exists to send Microsoft Entra activity logs to an appropriate destination

6.1.1.9.title: Ensure that Intune logs are captured and sent to Log Analytics

6.1.2.1.title: Ensure that Activity Log Alert exists for Create Policy Assignment

6.1.2.2.title: Ensure that Activity Log Alert exists for Delete Policy Assignment

6.1.2.3.title: Ensure that Activity Log Alert exists for Create or Update Network Security Group

6.1.2.4.title: Ensure that Activity Log Alert exists for Delete Network Security Group

6.1.2.5.title: Ensure that Activity Log Alert exists for Create or Update Security Solution

6.1.2.6.title: Ensure that Activity Log Alert exists for Delete Security Solution

6.1.2.7.title: Ensure that Activity Log Alert exists for Create or Update SQL Server Firewall Rule

6.1.2.8.title: Ensure that Activity Log Alert exists for Delete SQL Server Firewall Rule

6.1.2.9.title: Ensure that Activity Log Alert exists for Create or Update Public IP Address rule

6.1.2.10.title: Ensure that Activity Log Alert exists for Delete Public IP Address rule

6.1.2.11.title: Ensure that an Activity Log Alert exists for Service Health

6.1.4.title: Ensure that Azure Monitor resource logging is enabled for all services that support it

6.1.5.title: Ensure that SKU Basic/Consumption is not used on artifacts that need to be monitored

6.2.title: Ensure that resource locks are set for mission-critical Azure resources

7.1.title: Ensure that RDP access from the Internet is evaluated and restricted

7.2.title: Ensure that SSH access from the Internet is evaluated and restricted

7.3.title: Ensure that UDP access from the Internet is evaluated and restricted

7.4.title: Ensure that HTTP(S) access from the Internet is evaluated and restricted

7.5.title: Ensure that network security group flow log retention days is set to greater than or equal to 90

7.6.title: Ensure that Network Watcher is 'Enabled' for Azure regions that are in use

7.7.title: Ensure that Public IP addresses are evaluated on a periodic basis

7.8.title: Ensure that virtual network flow log retention days is set to greater than or equal to 90

7.9.title: Ensure 'Authentication type' is set to 'Azure Active Directory' only for Azure VPN Gateway point-to-site configuration

7.10.title: Ensure Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) is enabled on Azure Application Gateway

7.11.title: Ensure subnets are associated with network security groups

7.12.title: Ensure the SSL policy's 'Min protocol version' is set to 'TLSv1_2' or higher on Azure Application Gateway

7.13.title: Ensure 'HTTP2' is set to 'Enabled' on Azure Application Gateway

7.14.title: Ensure request body inspection is enabled in Azure Web Application Firewall policy on Azure Application Gateway

7.15.title: Ensure bot protection is enabled in Azure Web Application Firewall policy on Azure Application Gateway

7.16.title: Ensure Azure Network Security Perimeter is used to secure Azure platform-as-a-service resources

8.1.1.1.title: Ensure Microsoft Defender CSPM is set to 'On'

8.1.2.1.title: Ensure Microsoft Defender for APIs is set to 'On'

8.1.3.1.title: Ensure that Defender for Servers is set to 'On'

8.1.3.2.title: Ensure that 'Vulnerability assessment for machines' component status is set to 'On'

8.1.3.3.title: Ensure that 'Endpoint protection' component status is set to 'On'

8.1.3.4.title: Ensure that 'Agentless scanning for machines' component status is set to 'On'

8.1.3.5.title: Ensure that 'File Integrity Monitoring' component status is set to 'On'

8.1.4.1.title: Ensure that Microsoft Defender for Containers is set to 'On'

8.1.5.1.title: Ensure that Microsoft Defender for Storage is set to 'On'

8.1.5.2.title: Ensure Advanced Threat Protection alerts for storage accounts are monitored

8.1.6.1.title: Ensure that Microsoft Defender for App Services is set to 'On'

8.1.7.1.title: Ensure that Microsoft Defender for Azure Cosmos DB is set to 'On'

8.1.7.2.title: Ensure that Microsoft Defender for Open-Source Relational Databases is set to 'On'

8.1.7.3.title: Ensure that Microsoft Defender for (Managed Instance) Azure SQL Databases is set to 'On'

8.1.7.4.title: Ensure that Microsoft Defender for SQL Servers on Machines is set to 'On'

8.1.8.1.title: Ensure that Microsoft Defender for Key Vault is set to 'On'

8.1.9.1.title: Ensure that Microsoft Defender for Resource Manager is set to 'On'

8.1.10.title: Ensure that Microsoft Defender for Cloud is configured to check VM operating systems for updates

8.1.11.title: Ensure that Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark policies are not set to 'Disabled'

8.1.12.title: Ensure that 'All users with the following roles' is set to 'Owner'

8.1.13.title: Ensure 'Additional email addresses' is configured with a security contact email

8.1.14.title: Ensure that 'Notify about alerts with the following severity (or higher)' is enabled

8.1.15.title: Ensure that 'Notify about attack paths with the following risk level (or higher)' is enabled

8.1.16.title: Ensure that Microsoft Defender External Attack Surface Monitoring (EASM) is enabled

8.2.1.title: Ensure That Microsoft Defender for IoT Hub Is Set To 'On'

8.3.1.title: Ensure that the expiration date is set for all keys in RBAC key vaults

8.3.2.title: Ensure that the expiration date is set for all keys in non-RBAC key vaults

8.3.3.title: Ensure that the expiration date is set for all secrets in RBAC key vaults

8.3.4.title: Ensure that the expiration date is set for all secrets in non-RBAC key vaults

8.3.5.title: Ensure 'Purge protection' is enabled for all key vaults

8.3.6.title: Ensure that Role Based Access Control for Azure Key Vault is enabled

8.3.7.title: Ensure public network access is disabled for Azure Key Vault

8.3.8.title: Ensure private endpoints are used to access Azure Key Vault

8.3.9.title: Ensure automatic key rotation is enabled within Azure Key Vault

8.3.10.title: Ensure that Azure Key Vault Managed HSM is used when required

8.3.11.title: Ensure certificate 'Validity Period (in months)' is less than or equal to '12'

8.4.1.title: Ensure an Azure Bastion Host exists

8.5.title: Ensure Azure DDoS Network Protection is enabled on virtual networks

9.1.1.title: Ensure soft delete for Azure File Shares is enabled

9.1.2.title: Ensure 'SMB protocol version' is set to 'SMB 3.1.1' or higher for SMB file shares

9.1.3.title: Ensure 'SMB channel encryption' is set to 'AES-256-GCM' or higher for SMB file shares

9.2.1.title: Ensure that soft delete for blobs on Azure Blob Storage storage accounts is enabled

9.2.2.title: Ensure that soft delete for containers on Azure Blob Storage storage accounts is enabled

9.2.3.title: Ensure 'Versioning' is set to 'Enabled' on Azure Blob Storage storage accounts

9.3.1.1.title: Ensure that 'Enable key rotation reminders' is enabled for each storage account

9.3.1.2.title: Ensure that storage account access keys are periodically regenerated

9.3.1.3.title: Ensure 'Allow storage account key access' for Azure Storage Accounts is 'Disabled'

9.3.2.1.title: Ensure private endpoints are used to access storage accounts

9.3.2.2.title: Ensure that 'Public Network Access' is 'Disabled' for storage accounts

9.3.2.3.title: Ensure default network access rule for storage accounts is set to deny

9.3.3.1.title: Ensure that 'Default to Microsoft Entra authorization in the Azure portal' is set to 'Enabled'

9.3.4.title: Ensure that 'Secure transfer required' is set to 'Enabled'

9.3.5.title: Ensure 'Allow trusted Microsoft services to access this storage account' is enabled for storage account access

9.3.6.title: Ensure the 'Minimum TLS version' for storage accounts is set to 'Version 1.2'

9.3.7.title: Ensure 'Cross Tenant Replication' is not enabled

9.3.8.title: Ensure that 'Allow Blob Anonymous Access' is set to 'Disabled'

9.3.9.title: Ensure Azure Resource Manager Delete locks are applied to Azure Storage Accounts

9.3.10.title: Ensure Azure Resource Manager ReadOnly locks are considered for Azure Storage Accounts

9.3.11.title: Ensure redundancy is set to 'geo-redundant storage (GRS)' on critical Azure Storage Accounts
